results.name: auto_battle_survival_regression
results.stdout:
Auto Battle Survival 0.9.82FB: 16/16 PASS
PASS - item scripts dynamically expose every sc_end status
PASS - Green Potion and Green Herb use itemInfo fallback cure profiles
PASS - Panacea and Royal Jelly are detected without a name whitelist
PASS - narrow cheap cure is selected for poison only
PASS - one item covering more active ailments outranks a one-status herb
PASS - Panacea is preferred over Royal Jelly for curse when both are available
PASS - Royal Jelly clears ailments and applies script HP-SP recovery
PASS - learned cure skill is used before consuming an item
PASS - future learned heal-type cure skills are auto-discovered too
PASS - all status-cure items are reserved from normal HP-SP auto supply
PASS - critical HP butterfly return has priority over low-HP fly wing
PASS - escape thresholds are clamped to the requested 1-99 range
PASS - settings panel contains only direct controls and four numbered skill slots
PASS - number inputs use dark panel color and gold custom arrows
PASS - manual consumables also use itemheal and sc_end runtime helpers
PASS - butterfly wing runtime consumes item 602 and enters the selected city

passes: manual click starts attack while auto off
quick-slot accepts manually selected target excluded by auto filter
retaliation does not steal another manual target
world-stream attack calls manual retaliation bridge
world click branches between auto forced target and manual attack
world-stream aggressive attack starts retaliation with no selected target
world-stream aggressive attack preserves existing selected target
world-stream aggressive attack does not steal selected target
manual target path does not use auto monster whitelist

rootCause.alchemistAutoBattle: Saved attack skill IDs could be overwritten by an uninitialized empty skill selector; full settings DOM was also synchronized every battle utility tick.
rootCause.fireConverter: The character does not gain Fire intrinsically from this code path: the default physical attack element is Neutral unless weapon/card/active endow overrides it. The actual failure was that the dedicated endow applied first, then generic ConsumableRuntime rejected ITEM_ENCHANTARMS and returned before item consumption/persistence.
rootCause.townGhostCombat: Auto battle/manual retaliation state could remain eligible after travel without an explicit post-town passive-retaliation guard.

notes: Fixed flight is saved through position normalization and the scheduler wakes at its due time during long casts/action locks.
Boss/MVP avoidance scans the active battlefield before current-target combat and wakes at an 80ms polling ceiling while enabled.
Returning to town logs the stop message only when auto battle was active; passive retaliation stays suppressed until manual attack or auto battle is explicitly restarted.
V92 55-skill effect runtime remains intact and passes 24/24 regression checks.
